The '''Aargau Executive Board''' was an organization that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the occupation of Aargau by the [[Republic Military|armed forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Aargau Executive Board began exploring the possibility of Aargau's succession from the Republic. In response, the Republic dispatched [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] envoys, including the [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Gaddatha In'Kro]], to reach a compromise with the Board.<ref name="Insider 65" />
